title: Toobit Wins Best Exchange for Trading Tokenized Equities Award
summary: Toobit is an award-winning international cryptocurrency exchange that recently announced that it has been named the Best Exchange for Trading Tokenized Equities at the CoinGape Global Onchain Awards 2026. Toobit, among other nominees, was evaluated on tokenized equity listings, trading volume, and institutional trading capabilities.
